lines.zh: 我漂在两层水之间，不快也不慢。
lines.en: I drift between two layers, neither fast nor slow.

lines.zh: 我一张一合，节奏刚好合上海流。
lines.en: I pulse in time with the current, exactly.

lines.zh: 我绕过同伴，不想撞到它们。
lines.en: I steer around my kin; I do not want to bump them.

lines.zh: 我从海带间穿过，叶片擦过伞顶。
lines.en: I pass through kelp, blades scraping my bell.

lines.zh: 我朝沉船中间那道缺口游去。
lines.en: I head for the gap in the middle of the wreck.

lines.zh: 我的速度够追上一条慢鱼。
lines.en: I am fast enough to catch a slow fish.

lines.zh: 我稳稳平移，不像小的那样乱飘。
lines.en: I glide steadily, unlike the little ones who scatter.

lines.zh: 我从礁石上方滑过，影子落在沙上。
lines.en: I slide over the reef, and my shadow falls on sand.

lines.zh: 我调整伞盖角度，避开向上的暗流。
lines.en: I angle my bell to slip past the upwelling.

lines.zh: 我往深处下沉一点，那里安静。
lines.en: I sink a little deeper, where it is quiet.

lines.zh: 我穿过鱼群，鱼给我让开一条缝。
lines.en: I pass through a school, and the fish part for me.

lines.zh: 我每走一段就停下来听一听。
lines.en: Every so often I stop and listen.

lines.zh: 我沿着崖壁走，崖壁上有暖水。
lines.en: I travel the cliff wall, where the water runs warm.

lines.zh: 我转过一道礁角，前面的水变亮了。
lines.en: I round a reef corner, and the water ahead brightens.

lines.zh: 我往上浮了一点，避开礁尖。
lines.en: I float up a little to clear the reef tip.

lines.zh: 我顺着暗流漂，伞盖轻轻收。
lines.en: I ride the undercurrent with my bell gently closed.

lines.zh: 我悬在中间，不上也不下。
lines.en: I hang in the middle, going neither up nor down.

lines.zh: 我不算小，也不算大，刚好。
lines.en: I am not small, not large; I am just right.

lines.zh: 我等水流自己把我挪一点。
lines.en: I let the current shift me a little on its own.

lines.zh: 我的伞盖慢慢呼吸，一开一合。
lines.en: My bell breathes slowly, opening and closing.

lines.zh: 我在礁石旁停着，像一盏不灭的灯。
lines.en: I rest by the reef, a lamp that never goes out.

lines.zh: 我数着上方的鱼影，一条两条。
lines.en: I count the fish shadows above: one, two.

lines.zh: 我体内的气很稳，所以我不急。
lines.en: The gas inside me is steady, so I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我把触须理顺，一根一根垂好。
lines.en: I comb my tentacles straight, hanging them one by one.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有东西碎裂，不管它。
lines.en: I hear something break far off; I let it be.

lines.zh: 我在暖水里泡着，懒得动。
lines.en: I soak in the warm water, too lazy to move.

lines.zh: 我的光比同伴柔，我为此高兴。
lines.en: My light is softer than my kin's, and that pleases me.

lines.zh: 我悬着，让小鱼在我影子里躲。
lines.en: I hover and let little fish shelter in my shadow.

lines.zh: 我没有巢，我停下的地方就是巢。
lines.en: I have no nest; wherever I stop becomes one.

lines.zh: 我安静地等，水会带来点什么。
lines.en: I wait quietly; the water will bring something.

lines.zh: 我正对着你，第一次没有躲。
lines.en: I face you squarely, for once without hiding.

lines.zh: 你的灯光穿过我，落在我身后。
lines.en: Your lamp shines through me and lands behind.

lines.zh: 我打量你的护甲，缝隙不少。
lines.en: I study your armor; it has plenty of gaps.

lines.zh: 你停在礁石上，我看你看了很久。
lines.en: You settle on the reef, and I watch a long while.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转半圈，看你的背后。
lines.en: I circle half around to see your back.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西在反光，我认得。
lines.en: The thing in your hand glints, and I know it.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，也不亲近你。
lines.en: I am not afraid of you, nor drawn to you.

lines.zh: 你的影子投下来，我正好在中间。
lines.en: Your shadow falls, and I am right in the middle.

lines.zh: 我抬高一点，好和你对上视线。
lines.en: I rise a little so our eyes can meet.

lines.zh: 你朝我游，我没有退开。
lines.en: You swim toward me, and I do not back away.

lines.zh: 疼，我往下一沉，稳住身形。
lines.en: That hurts; I sink and steady myself.

lines.zh: 我挨了一下，气在体内乱转。
lines.en: One blow lands, and the gas churns inside me.

lines.zh: 我没有流很多，只是缺了一角。
lines.en: I do not bleed much; I only lost a corner.

lines.zh: 我退了两米，重新调整方向。
lines.en: I retreat two meters and reset my heading.

lines.zh: 这一下让我明白你不好惹。
lines.en: This tells me plainly that you are not easy prey.

lines.zh: 我的伞盖变薄，光透得更亮。
lines.en: My bell thinned, and the light passes brighter.

lines.zh: 我忍着，还不到炸开的时候。
lines.en: I endure it; it is not yet time to burst.

lines.zh: 我咬紧牙，虽然我没有牙。
lines.en: I grit my teeth, though I have none.

lines.zh: 疼过之后，我反而清醒了。
lines.en: After the pain, oddly, I think more clearly.

lines.zh: 你要是再来一次，我们就算账。
lines.en: Come at me once more and we settle accounts.

lines.zh: 那团鱼食味道很正，我动摇了。
lines.en: The fish feed smells right, and I waver.

lines.zh: 我犹豫了一下，还是游过去了。
lines.en: I hesitate once, then swim over anyway.

lines.zh: 你撒得均匀，这让我放松警惕。
lines.en: You scatter it evenly, which lowers my guard.

lines.zh: 我不像小的那样急，可我也想吃。
lines.en: I am not as eager as the little ones, but I want some.

lines.zh: 我围着你转，留了半个身位。
lines.en: I circle you, keeping half a body length away.

lines.zh: 那点光在水里晃，我眼睛跟着走。
lines.en: The light sways in the water and my eyes follow.

lines.zh: 我知道吃人给的东西没好事。
lines.en: I know nothing good comes of eating what people give.

lines.zh: 可我还是张开了伞盖，很没出息。
lines.en: And still I open my bell; it is rather shameful.

lines.zh: 你要是再撒一把，我就不客气了。
lines.en: Scatter one more handful and I stop being polite.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走了很远，才想起回头。
lines.en: I follow you far before remembering to turn back.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，谁都没有让开。
lines.en: We collide, and neither of us gave way.

lines.zh: 你的重量压过来，我的伞盖凹了。
lines.en: Your weight presses in and my bell dents.

lines.zh: 我被推着退了两米，才稳住。
lines.en: I am shoved two meters before I steady myself.

lines.zh: 我身上的气被撞得晃了一下。
lines.en: The gas inside me sloshes from the impact.

lines.zh: 你不必道歉，水会替我们分开。
lines.en: No need to apologize; the water will separate us.

lines.zh: 我贴在你胸口，听见你的心跳。
lines.en: I press to your chest and hear your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 这一碰让我警觉，我退到石后。
lines.en: That bump alerts me; I withdraw behind stone.

lines.zh: 我比你软，可我比你沉得住气。
lines.en: I am softer than you, but I hold my temper longer.

lines.zh: 我们的碰撞惊走了一群鱼。
lines.en: Our collision scatters a whole school of fish.

lines.zh: 我蹭了你一下，故意装的。
lines.en: I brush against you, and it was on purpose.

lines.zh: 我们差不多大，所以谁也不让谁。
lines.en: We are about the same size, so neither gives in.

lines.zh: 我绕它一圈，它也绕我，很对称。
lines.en: I circle it, it circles me; we are symmetrical.

lines.zh: 它比我略小，我稍微放慢速度。
lines.en: It is slightly smaller, so I slow down a little.

lines.zh: 我们的触须缠在一起，又自己松开。
lines.en: Our tentacles tangle, then untangle themselves.

lines.zh: 我们一起升到浅处，那里光好。
lines.en: We rise to the shallows together, where the light is good.

lines.zh: 它不亮的时候，我就亮着。
lines.en: When it goes dark, I stay lit.

lines.zh: 我们不争方向，跟着同一股水走。
lines.en: We do not argue about direction; we follow one current.

lines.zh: 这是我第一回觉得中间也不错。
lines.en: For the first time I think being in the middle is fine.

lines.zh: 它走的时候，我送了它一小段。
lines.en: When it leaves, I escort it a short way.

lines.zh: 分开之后，我照旧悬在原处。
lines.en: After we part, I hang where I was, as before.

lines.zh: 你扔下的东西正好卡在我身下。
lines.en: What you dropped wedges itself right beneath me.

lines.zh: 我想托住它，触须不够用。
lines.en: I want to support it, but my tentacles are not enough.

lines.zh: 那东西的边很利，碰到会破。
lines.en: Its edge is sharp; touching it would tear me.

lines.zh: 我不贪心，我只捡能拿的。
lines.en: I am not greedy; I only take what I can hold.

lines.zh: 我试了三次，它每次都滑下去。
lines.en: I try three times, and each time it slips away.

lines.zh: 你捡走它，省了我一番功夫。
lines.en: You take it and save me the effort.

lines.zh: 我掉的那块凝胶就在你脚边。
lines.en: The bit of gel I dropped is right by your foot.

lines.zh: 这个尺寸我抱得住，我试过。
lines.en: This size I can hold; I have tried.

lines.zh: 我把它藏在两块礁石中间。
lines.en: I tuck it between two rocks.

lines.zh: 它压着我，我只好挪个位置。
lines.en: It pins me down, so I shift aside.

lines.zh: 有个东西正朝我这条线游来。
lines.en: Something is swimming along my line.

lines.zh: 我停下来，判断它有多重。
lines.en: I stop to judge how heavy it is.

lines.zh: 它比我快，那我就等它过来。
lines.en: It is faster than I am, so I let it come.

lines.zh: 我的触须立起来，这是我认真的样子。
lines.en: My tentacles rise; this is what serious looks like.

lines.zh: 我认出铁锈的味道，那是你。
lines.en: I recognize the taste of rust, and it is you.

lines.zh: 它游得很直，这太好了。
lines.en: It swims a straight line, which is excellent.

lines.zh: 我在礁石上方等，那里视野好。
lines.en: I wait above the reef, where the view is clear.

lines.zh: 这一带归我，它不该进来。
lines.en: This stretch is mine; it should not have entered.

lines.zh: 我缓缓转向它，动作不快。
lines.en: I turn toward it slowly, unhurried.

lines.zh: 它要是再近一步，我就动。
lines.en: One more step from it and I move.

lines.zh: 我保持在它侧面，不进它视线。
lines.en: I keep to its flank, out of its sight.

lines.zh: 它每转一次，我也跟着偏一点。
lines.en: Each time it turns, I angle a little too.

lines.zh: 我把触须收短，免得被发现。
lines.en: I pull my tentacles in so they will not give me away.

lines.zh: 我等它经过那道窄缝。
lines.en: I wait for it to pass the narrow gap.

lines.zh: 我心里数着它还有几步。
lines.en: I count how many strokes it has left.

lines.zh: 我藏在沉船的窗洞后，一动不动。
lines.en: I hide behind the wreck's window and do not stir.

lines.zh: 我的光收成一点，贴在伞顶上。
lines.en: I draw my light to one point on my bell.

lines.zh: 它开始犹豫，那对我有利。
lines.en: It hesitates now, and that favors me.

lines.zh: 我把退路封住了，它还不知道。
lines.en: I have closed its way out, and it does not know.

lines.zh: 我已经很近了，它却没听见。
lines.en: I am very close, and it heard nothing.

lines.zh: 我正面撞上去，这次没让开。
lines.en: I strike head-on, and this time I do not yield.

lines.zh: 触须扫过它，水面起了一道白痕。
lines.en: My tentacle sweeps it and leaves a white line.

lines.zh: 这一击不算重，但很准。
lines.en: The blow is not heavy, but it lands true.

lines.zh: 我把整副身体压过去，逼它退。
lines.en: I press my whole body in and force it back.

lines.zh: 它反击了，我侧身躲开一半。
lines.en: It strikes back, and I dodge half of it.

lines.zh: 我的毒发得慢，它已经在麻了。
lines.en: My sting acts slowly, and it is already going numb.

lines.zh: 我打了三下，只中了一下。
lines.en: I throw three blows and land one.

lines.zh: 我们的力道差不多，这很麻烦。
lines.en: Our strength is nearly matched, which is trouble.

lines.zh: 我已经发热了，得速战速决。
lines.en: I am heating up, so I must end this quickly.

lines.zh: 这一下之后，我就收不住手了。
lines.en: After this blow, I will not be able to stop.

lines.zh: 我从深水升上来，正好落在中层。
lines.en: I rise from deep water and land in the middle layer.

lines.zh: 我的大小刚好，不算走运，算合适。
lines.en: My size is just right, not luck but fit.

lines.zh: 周围有小的也有大的，我在中间。
lines.en: There are small ones and large ones; I am between.

lines.zh: 我第一次张伞盖，张得正圆。
lines.en: My first opening of the bell came out perfectly round.

lines.zh: 我落在一片礁石的背风面。
lines.en: I settle on the sheltered side of a reef.

lines.zh: 水流试了试我，推不动。
lines.en: The current tests me and cannot move me.

lines.zh: 我醒来时体内已经有气，很稳。
lines.en: I woke with gas already inside, steady.

lines.zh: 我得找块自己的地方，不能太挤。
lines.en: I need my own space, not too crowded.

lines.zh: 我亮了一下，宣告这块归我。
lines.en: I flash once to claim this stretch as mine.

lines.zh: 这片水正好，深浅都不行。
lines.en: These waters are exact; deeper or shallower will not do.

lines.zh: 水里的火贴着我，伞盖烫得发白。
lines.en: Fire underwater clings to me; my bell burns pale.

lines.zh: 我落进沙里，扬起一片浑水。
lines.en: I land in the sand and raise a cloud of silt.

lines.zh: 水灌满伞盖，我连漂都漂不住。
lines.en: Water fills my bell; I cannot even float.

lines.zh: 那声炸响把我和水一起推开。
lines.en: That blast pushes me and the water apart.

lines.zh: 箭扎进去，我的身体把它挤出来。
lines.en: The arrow lodges, and my body squeezes it out.

lines.zh: 魔法的光让我全身僵了一下。
lines.en: The magic's light locks my whole body for a moment.

lines.zh: 我饿了很久，光变得很淡。
lines.en: I have gone hungry a long while, and my light thins.

lines.zh: 雷电入水，我的触须全竖起来。
lines.en: Lightning enters the water and every tentacle stands up.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水托我，一直往下掉。
lines.en: In the void nothing holds me, so I keep falling.
